description: Given a name, word, or initials, intelligently suggests number plates that would make for a good match.

available_only.description: Return only registrations currently available. Defaults to false if omitted.

max_price_gbp.description: Optional ceiling price. Only registrations with asking prices less than this figure will be returned. If omitted, no maximum price limit is applied.

min_price_gbp.description: Optional floor price. Only registrations with asking prices greater than this figure will be returned.

query.description: A name, word or initials containing only letters, numbers and spaces

registration_types.description: Optional plate formats to restrict matching to. If omitted, matching plates of all formats will be returned.

sort_by.description: Field used to order search results. Defaults to relevance.

sort_order.description: Direction used to order search results.

registration.description: The vehicle's current registration mark, used to determine its age.

first_registered_on.description: The vehicle's exact first-registration date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

first_registered_year.description: The vehicle's known first-registration year. Treated conservatively as the start of that year.

vehicle_age_reference.description: Optional vehicle-age restriction. Results will only include registrations suitable for a vehicle of this age. Provide the vehicle's current registration, its first registration date (YYYY-MM-DD), or year of registration. When only a year is supplied, later registration releases from that same year will be excluded.

name: suggest_registrations
title: Suggest registrations
